title: Drone Roof Nonrenewal Sprint
oneLiner: Homeowners respond to insurer drone-photo roof threats with repair proof, inspection asks, and a renewal appeal timeline.
targetUser: Homeowners who receive roof-condition notices, drone-photo inspection claims, cancellation threats, or nonrenewal letters from insurers.
keyUx: Log the insurer notice, request inspection evidence, attach roofer photos, track repair proof, and draft a nonrenewal appeal or broker call script.
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive field-ops app called “Drone Roof Nonrenewal Sprint” for homeowners facing insurer drone-photo roof notices. Include notice intake, deadline countdown, inspection-photo request checklist, roofer proof board, targeted repair vs full replacement lane, insurer response timeline, broker call script, and renewal appeal packet. Design direction: use the field-ops profile with sturdy forms, photo evidence rails, high-contrast deadlines, practical mobile-first controls, and restrained emergency color only for renewal dates.
